raw_text: Reuters Fact Check has verified that a video purportedly showing Ukrainian President Zelenskyy announcing surrender is a deepfake. Ukrainian officials confirmed no such address was made. Digital forensics analysis by multiple independent researchers identified AI-generated facial movements and synthetic audio. The video was first observed on pro-Russian Telegram channels before spreading to other platforms.
